text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I won! ♪ I actually won, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. The race is over, but my heart
won't stop
pounding!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The cheers that erupted when I crossed
the finish
line! The fervor of the winner's
circle! It was all so
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The cheers that erupted when I crossed
the finish
line! The fervor of the winner's
circle! It was all so
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll never ever forget today's
race!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just that I won, it's the
experience of
pulling it off with you! I
think that's what I
treasure most about
today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me! ♪ Let's take a picture
to
remember things by! Okay, selfie
mode... on.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Trainer. ♪ Would you mind
coming
closer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... As long as I have this picture, no
matter
how many years pass, I'll be able
to remember
exactly what happened
today in vivid detail. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion looks extremely pleased,
and our
memorial selfie comes out great.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I will make sure to! But that means
we mustn't
let our guard down. We've
got to keep up this
momentum! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This might seem sudden, but with that in
mind,
would you mind if we did some
training when we
get back?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to get back on the track while the

experience is still fresh in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Right, let's aim for another
splendid
win next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion has already set her gallant
gaze on
the next race.
